automation_evidence.quote:
The agent selects among nine strategy families and their parameters, while deterministic
resolvers map these decisions into contracts, position sizes, and hedges.

metric_evidence.quote:
SOTA earns a total return of 18.32%, an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.60, and a maximum drawdown
of 8.96%.

evidence.quote:

checkpoint fixed, we compare reinforcement learning with and without contemporaneous news

practical_problems.note: ablation of the news context source: news helps the teacher but retaining it in RL drops return from 18.32% to -2.72%

summary: Trains an LLM to select option strategies with deterministic resolvers, earning positive out-of-sample return where rule-based and machine-learning baselines lose; the only isolated obstacle test is the news ablation.
